findings.title: Rumi patch creates a rectangular step in Roshan’s foreground fin
findings.reference_pixels: 1512×1080 proof, approximately x278–296, y732–736. Exact inspected close-up crop: [240,660,325,765].
findings.observed: Roshan’s foreground pink/orange fin contour abruptly steps inward at a hard horizontal rectangular ledge. This is visible in the actual final proof and enlarged tail detail. The native Rumi crop contains Roshan’s fin; its 315-to-340 document-width fit shifts those foreground pixels relative to the original. The Rumi polygon still exposes part of that shifted fin before ending at the original contour. The parent independently confirmed this counterexample.
findings.criterion: Only Daddy/Rumi lower tails are being repaired on the cover; retained Roshan and local occlusion/contours must remain intact. A green outside-declared-mask gate does not establish that pixels inside a permissive mask satisfy the named repair scope.
findings.required_correction: Tighten the Rumi exposure to exclude both the shifted generated foreground-fin footprint and the original Roshan fin silhouette; retain the original Roshan contour/pixels and clean intervening floor. Preserve the new Rumi fork and Daddy fin. No new generation or transformation of Roshan is needed. Inspect the entire occlusion edge at original and enlarged scale, not just the two fin tips.
